description: This file implements character encoding conversions between Unicode and various code pages, specifically for SBCS (Single Byte Character Set) code pages. It includes tables for multiple code pages, functions for conversion and uppercase transformation, and is tailored for use with FatFs or similar filesystem libraries.

methods.name: ff_convert
methods.description: Converts a character between Unicode and OEM code page based on direction parameter.

methods.name: ff_wtoupper
methods.description: Converts a character to its uppercase equivalent, supporting extended characters.

calls: for (c = 0; c < 0x80; c++) if (chr == Tbl[c]) break;
